SWE.Title: Simple weapon editor
SWE.OverLimit: Property runes exceed the potency limit
SWE.NotAWeapon: This editor only works on weapons.
SWE.OverLimitBlocked: Too many property runes for that potency. Enable GM free mode to save anyway.
SWE.SettingGmOnlyHint: If disabled, players who own a weapon can also open the editor.
SWE.NoRuneDesc: No description found in the compendium for this rune.
SWE.DerivedPriceHint: Total value computed by the system (base price + runes). Read only.
SWE.TotalPriceHint: Total price shown on the sheet. Type a custom value to override it; clear the field to go back to the automatic price.
SWE.SplashHint: hits everything within 5 ft on a hit; the target keeps it even on a miss. Uses the base damage type.
SWE.EditInConds: Edited in the Conditions tab. Deleting here removes the condition.
SWE.SplashBlockHint: own amount and type; also hits everything within 5 ft
SWE.SaveTitle: Save or check to resist this damage
SWE.DcAutoHint: The higher of the wielder's class DC and spell DC (0 if neither).
SWE.NoStatistic: the target has no such statistic; resolve manually
SWE.NoteHalf: Roll the save, then the damage button: full on a failure, half on a success, none on a critical success.
SWE.NoteNone: Only on a failed save, roll the damage button and apply it.
SWE.HitCondsHint: conditions applied when the strike's damage is rolled
SWE.HitCondValue: Value, for conditions that have one (e.g. frightened 2)
SWE.PickRowHint: To choose: ask before each attack whether to add this damage (the last choice is remembered).
SWE.PickHint: Check the damage to add to this attack. Your choice is remembered for the next one.
SWE.StrikingIgnored: striking does not change the dice here (manual dice count)
SWE.PriceFloor: Runes alone are worth more than that; minimum total
SWE.CondHint: Effects that only apply depending on who carries the weapon.
SWE.CondUnknown: This option is not in any installed compendium, so it will never match
SWE.CondNoTarget: Conditions with nothing selected were not saved
SWE.Filter_map: is attacking with the multiple attack penalty (MAP)
SWE.Filter_selfCondition: the wielder is suffering the condition
SWE.Filter_targetCondition: the target is suffering the condition
SWE.BonusTypeHint: Bonus type. Same-type bonuses do not stack with each other; untyped ones always do.
SWE.BonusValueHint: Modifier to the attack roll. Negative values are penalties.
SWE.MinHint: Minimum value (e.g. 2 for frightened 2 or more). Leave empty to just require the condition.
SWE.Effect_healTurn: healing at the start of the turn
SWE.CondInert: Start-of-turn healing has no attack or target to check, so this requirement never holds there.
SWE.ArmNotDefense: This editor only works on armor and shields.
SWE.ArmStrengthHint: Strength modifier that ignores the check penalty and reduces the speed penalty by 5 ft. Leave empty for none.
SWE.ArmNoStrengthWarn: With no Strength requirement PF2e never applies the check penalty.
SWE.ArmSpecialization: Armor specialization (if the wearer has it from their class)
SWE.ArmInvestHint: Rules on this armor only work while it is worn in its slot, and invested if it is magical.
SWE.ShEquipHint: Rules on this shield only work while it is held. Mark a row "raised" to require Raise a Shield.
SWE.ArmExceptHint: Exception: the protection does not apply to this type (e.g. resistance to physical except adamantine).
SWE.ArmRaisedHint: Only while the shield is raised
SWE.ArmItemStackHint: An item bonus to AC does not stack with the armor's own item bonus: only the higher one applies.
SWE.ArmPotencyHint: Potency only adds to AC, and resilient to saves, while the armor is worn and invested.
SWE.ArmABPWarn: Automatic Bonus Progression is on: PF2e ignores potency and resilient runes and gives those bonuses by level.
SWE.ArmRunesInertHint: PF2e does not automate armor property runes. This module adds the rules each rune can honestly be expressed with, and its engine resolves a few runes during play (fortification, dread, unnerving...), which needs a GM connected; see each card. Everything acts only while the rune is on the armor. A rune made of rules that was added from the system's sheet gets them the next time you save here; the engine's runes work right away.
SWE.ShReinforcingHint: The reinforcing rune raises the shield's Hardness and HP; the system applies it on top of the base values.
SWE.ArmModValueHint: Modifier to the chosen defense, save, skill, Perception or Speed. Negative values are penalties.
SWE.ShCircHint: A circumstance bonus to AC does not stack with the circumstance bonus of Raise a Shield: only the higher one applies.
SWE.ShMaterialHint: This shield's precious material sets its Hardness and HP; editing the base values may have no effect.
SWE.ArmPriceLockedHint: PF2e prices this item from its runes and material and ignores the base price, so it cannot be edited here.
SWE.ArmCondHint: Effects that only apply depending on who wears it, or on the attacker.
SWE.ArmEffect_healTurn: healing at the start of the turn
SWE.ArmFilter_originCondition: the attacker is suffering the condition
SWE.ArmCondInert: The attacker is only known while an attack or effect is checked against the wearer, so this card never applies. Use this requirement on a defensive modifier to AC, saves, Perception or skills.
SWE.ArmFilter_selfCondition: the wearer is suffering the condition
SWE.ArmRuneAbpPartial: (Under ABP, its item bonuses are suppressed.)
SWE.ArmEffect_tempTurn: temporary HP at the start of the turn
SWE.ArmTempTurnHint: Granted at the start of the wearer's turn, only when higher than the temporary HP they already have. PF2e applies a fixed amount itself and the module rolls dice; both need a GM connected.
SWE.ArmReactHint: Effects that fire on their own when the wearer is attacked. Hits resolve when the attacker rolls damage against the wearer; "when damaged" and the shield triggers resolve when the damage is applied.
SWE.ArmReactFooter: Reactions need a GM connected. "When hit" and "when critically hit" need the attacker to target the wearer: those attacks trigger nothing without a target. "When damaged" and the shield triggers fire whenever the damage is applied to the wearer.
SWE.ArmFortDcHint: Each critical hit against the wearer rolls a flat check against this DC; on a success it becomes a normal hit. 0 turns it off.
SWE.ArmFortHint: With several sources the engine uses the lowest DC and rolls a single check per critical hit. Needs a GM connected and the attacker targeting the wearer.
SWE.ArmReactTrigger_blockHurt: on a block that damages the shield
SWE.ArmReactTrigger_blockZero: on a block that stops all the damage
SWE.ArmReactTriggerHint: "When hit" includes critical hits. Hits resolve when the attacker rolls damage; "when damaged" and the blocks when the damage is applied.
SWE.ArmReactAmountHint: Rolled dice, or as much damage as the shield's current Hardness.
SWE.ArmReactBonus: Flat amount added to the damage
SWE.ArmReactPersHint: Deal it as persistent damage: the attacker gets the persistent damage condition (with a save, only when it fails).
SWE.ArmReactTempHint: Only when higher than the temporary HP the wearer already has.
SWE.ArmDcAutoHint: The higher of the wearer's class DC and spell DC. When they have neither, the DC typed here is used.
SWE.ArmReactFreqHint: Once per round lasts until the start of the wearer's next turn, like a reaction. Turn and round limits do not count outside combat. Once per minute and once per hour follow the world clock, which only moves in combat (6 seconds a round) or when the GM moves it. Resting for the night resets once per minute, hour and day for a character; other creatures get their once per day back after 24 hours of world time.
SWE.ArmReactSrcPh: Name shown in chat (e.g. spiked armor)
SWE.ArmReactNoReqs: None: it fires every time its trigger happens.
SWE.ArmReactReqDropped: Requirements with nothing selected were not saved; their reactions now fire without them
SWE.ArmReactSaveHint: Save that can resist the effect. With no save it always applies.
SWE.EngNoToken: no token on the scene; resolve manually
SWE.EngFailed: could not be applied; resolve manually
SWE.EngTempNotHigher: not above the current {current} temporary HP
SWE.EngFortPending: Fortification: the flat check is still being rolled
SWE.EngFortBlocked: Fortification turned this critical hit into a hit
SWE.EngFortGmForce: Fortification turned this critical hit into a hit. As GM, this button still forces critical damage.
SWE.EngFortDowngraded: Fortification turned that critical hit into a hit: rolling normal damage.
SWE.EngFortSpellX1: Fortification turned the critical hit of {item} on {target} into a hit. Spell damage is rolled from the spell and doubled by hand, so apply it ×1, not doubled.
SWE.EngFortCritRolled: {actor} rolled critical damage for an attack that Fortification turned into a hit on {target}: use the attack's normal damage instead.
SWE.EngUnnervingLine: −1 circumstance penalty to {attacker}'s next melee Strike against {wearer}
SWE.EngUnnervedDesc: −1 circumstance penalty to your next melee Strike against {wearer} before the end of their next turn (Unnerving rune). The effect ends after that Strike.
SWE.EngDreadHeld: frightened can't drop below {value} this turn
SWE.EngDreadHoldDesc: A dread rune keeps this creature's frightened from decreasing. While this effect is on, lowering frightened by hand does nothing; delete the effect to lower it.
SWE.EngDreadOtherScene: {name}'s turn ended near a dread rune, but the canvas of {gm} (the GM client running the automation) is not on {scene}, so range and line of sight can't be measured: the dread save was skipped and frightened decreases as usual.
SWE.EngDreadNoCanvas: {name}'s turn ended near a dread rune, but {gm} (the GM client running the automation) has the game canvas turned off, so range and line of sight can't be measured: the dread save was skipped and frightened decreases as usual.
SWE.EngBitterNoOrigin: {wearer} was engulfed or swallowed whole, but the effect doesn't say by whom: apply sickened 1 to that creature by hand.
SWE.EngAdvancing: {wearer} dropped {foe} to 0 HP: {rune} lets {wearer} Stride {distance} as a free action, without triggering reactions (or Burrow, Climb, Fly or Swim with that Speed).
